ifsc.say: IFSC is your bank branch's 11-character code, like SBIN0001234. It's on your cheque book or in your bank app.

rows.What it is: An 11-character code that identifies your bank branch.
rows.Where to find it: On your cheque book, your passbook or in your bank app.
rows.Format: 4 letters, a zero, then 6 letters or numbers, like SBIN0001234.
rows.Common mistake: Typing the letter O instead of the zero in the fifth place.

pan.say: PAN is your 10-character tax ID, like ABCDE1234F. It's printed on your PAN card.

rows.What it is: Your Permanent Account Number, the tax ID from the Income Tax Department.
rows.Where to find it: On your PAN card, or on the income tax e-filing site.

ckyc.say: A CKYC number is your 14-digit central KYC ID, which saves you re-submitting documents. It's on your CKYC card or in a bank's KYC email.

rows.What it is: A 14-digit ID from India's central KYC registry.
rows.Where to find it: In a KYC confirmation SMS or email from a bank, or on the CKYC card.
rows.Common mistake: Entering your PAN or Aadhaar number instead.

mandate type.say: This asks how your EMIs will be collected: NACH, which is an auto-debit from your bank account, or UPI AutoPay. Either way, the money leaves automatically.

rows.What it is: The way the lender will collect your EMIs automatically.
rows.Where to find it: You choose it here; both options link to your bank account.
rows.Format: Pick one of the options, NACH e-mandate or UPI AutoPay.

gstin.say: GSTIN is a business's 15-character GST registration number, like 27ABCDE1234F1Z5. Leave it blank if you're buying as a person.

rows.Where to find it: On the business's GST certificate or its invoices.

nominee.say: A nominee is the person who receives the money if something happens to you. You usually give their name and how they're related to you.

rows.What it is: The person who would receive the benefit on your behalf.
rows.Where to find it: Your choice; you'll need their full name and relationship to you.
rows.Format: Full name as on their ID.
